title: 今天从简单处开始
description: 成人从地面观察最低一段大把手路线，同伴在旁听。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands beside a companion outside the mat and studies the lowest section of a short easy route with oversized holds. Their hands remain relaxed, and the companion follows the gaze rather than pushing toward a challenge. A broad foot step and obvious descent holds are central in the frame. Show an inviting low wall, continuous mats, and a nearby bench, making the choice of a comfortable start visible without printed grades. Use dry-brush acrylic illustration with blocky forms, textured edge transitions, and a clear gray-green, persimmon, and cream palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
